label: Very sparse (about 30 corpus tokens): the second or middle subword piece of rare multi-token proper nouns, mostly place, tribe and disease names, after a short capitalised first piece (Tul|are, Tul|arem|ia, Tuil|eries, Nure|m|berg, Tus|car|ora, Y|arem|uth, Luperc|us, Tar|quin) — a name-completion detector for unusual foreign-looking names
